description: Aggregated progress of a video batch started by lab_animate_batch. Returns {total, completed, failed, pending, done, items[]} — poll this ONCE per batch instead of calling lab_job_status per clip. `done: true` means nothing is pending any more (some items may still have failed). Each item carries retry_count (an automatic second attempt happened) and fallback_from (the provider was swapped after a content-policy rejection).

batch_id.description: The batch_id returned by lab_animate_batch (format: vb_<hex>)

name: lab_batch_status
title: Batch Status
